title: What Open-Source Projects Tell Their Coding Agents: A Census of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md
title_zh: 开源项目向其编码智能体传达了什么：对 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md 的普查

paragraphs.en: Coding agents can be guided with instruction files in a repository. We examine this emerging practice through a census of 22,854 popular, active GitHub repositories in thirteen languages, treating each repository’s root AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md as one instruction set. Agent instructions appear in 26.3% of repositories and 59.6% of the most-starred; where both files exist, CLAUDE.md usually points to AGENTS.md . We analyse 341,852 statements using model-assisted annotation and human review. The annotations reveal a practical mix of project knowledge and rules about code, building and workflow. Collaboration rules name concrete requirements, from test plans to commit formats, yet 74.0% of directives give no reason. Projects disagree on AI attribution: commit-message rules more often prohibit it than require it, while pull-request rules more often require disclosure. A third of instruction sets have a generator-associated signature, a tool-inserted block, shared text or an AI-marked creation commit; four in five are edited after creation. Prespecified tests associate repository popularity with rules on pull requests and AI contributions. Exploratory analyses link activity to process-oriented content and show that LLM and agent projects are over-represented among adopters. The models agree much more closely with each other than with the human reviewer’s topic assignments, a caution for automated annotation. We release the annotations, taxonomies and pointers to the analysed file versions.
paragraphs.zh: 编程智能体可以通过仓库中的指令文件来进行引导。 我们通过对十三种语言中 22,854 个热门且活跃的 GitHub 仓库进行普查来考察这一新兴实践，将每个仓库根目录下的 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md 视为一个指令集。 智能体指令出现在 26.3% 的仓库中，在最受星标的仓库中占 59.6%；当两个文件同时存在时，CLAUDE.md 通常指向 AGENTS.md。 我们借助模型辅助标注和人工审查，分析了 341,852 条语句。 标注结果揭示了项目知识与关于代码、构建和工作流的规则的实际组合。 协作规则指明具体要求，从测试计划到提交格式，然而 74.0% 的指令没有给出理由。 各项目在 AI 署名问题上意见不一：提交信息规则禁止署名的多于要求署名的，而拉取请求规则更多要求披露。 三分之一的指令集带有生成器相关的签名、工具插入的代码块、共享文本或由 AI 标记的创建提交；五分之四的指令集在创建后经过编辑。 预设的检验将仓库受欢迎程度与关于拉取请求和 AI 贡献的规则相关联。 探索性分析将活动度与面向流程的内容联系起来，并表明 LLM 与智能体项目在采用者中被过度代表。 各模型之间的共识远高于其与人工标注者在主题划分上的一致性，这是对自动化标注的一个警示。 我们公开了标注结果、分类体系以及指向所分析文件版本的链接。

paragraphs.en: Human contributors learn a project’s norms through review: which commands to run, what a pull request must contain, when a change is done. Coding agents, which now work in open-source repositories at scale [ Robbes et al., 2026a , Li et al., 2026 ] , often start a task without that history, so projects write the norms down for them, mostly in two root files: AGENTS.md , an open format that calls itself a README for agents [ AGENTS.md, 2026 ] , and CLAUDE.md , which Claude Code reads [ Anthropic, 2026b ] . Whether such files help agents is contested [ Gloaguen et al., 2026 , Lulla et al., 2026 ] , so it matters what projects put in them. Existing studies characterise them on repositories already tied to agent use [ Chatlatanagulchai et al., 2026 ] or screen broad samples under other definitions, with adoption estimates from 5% of mature repositories [ Mohsenimofidi et al., 2026 ] to 21.7% of agent-using ones [ Díaz et al., 2026 ] . What popular projects write, statement by statement, where that text comes from and what it varies with is not known.
paragraphs.zh: 人类贡献者通过代码审查来学习一个项目的规范：要运行哪些命令、拉取请求必须包含什么、何时算完成一项修改。 目前已在大规模开源仓库中工作的编码智能体 [Robbes et al., 2026a, Li et al., 2026] 往往在缺乏这段历史的情况下开始任务，因此项目会把规范写下来给它们，主要写在两个根文件中：AGENTS.md，一种自称「智能体的 README」的开放格式 [AGENTS.md, 2026]；以及 Claude Code 会读取的 CLAUDE.md [Anthropic, 2026b]。 此类文件是否对智能体有帮助仍有争议 [Gloaguen et al., 2026, Lulla et al., 2026]，因此项目在其中写了什么内容十分重要。 现有研究要么是对已经与智能体使用相关联的仓库进行刻画 [Chatlatanagulchai et al., 2026]，要么是依据其他定义对大样本进行筛选，其采用率估计从成熟仓库的 5% [Mohsenimofidi et al., 2026] 到使用智能体的仓库的 21.7% [Díaz et al., 2026] 不等。 热门项目逐条写下了什么、这些文本来自哪里、又随什么而变化，目前尚不清楚。

paragraphs.en: We answer these questions with a census of 22,854 public GitHub repositories returned by GitHub’s search API in thirteen languages with at least 1,000 stars and recent activity, and treat each repository’s AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md as one instruction set . We ask who has agent instructions (RQ1), what they contain (RQ2), how instructions are expressed (RQ3), where their content comes from (RQ4) and what it varies with (RQ5). Analysing the files together, down to individual statements, lets us examine both the requirements projects give their agents and the traces of generators, tools and shared text in those requirements. We combine this account with adoption and file-history measurements, prespecified hypothesis tests and exploratory associations with project characteristics. We release file-version pointers, annotations, taxonomies and aggregate results, without redistributing the corpus texts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过对 GitHub 搜索 API 返回的 22,854 个公共 GitHub 仓库进行普查来回答这些问题——这些仓库涵盖十三种语言、至少拥有 1,000 颗星且有近期活动，并将每个仓库的 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md 视为一个指令集。 我们询问谁在编写智能体指令（RQ1）、指令包含什么内容（RQ2）、指令如何表达（RQ3）、指令内容来自何处（RQ4）以及其随什么而变化（RQ5）。 对这些文件进行整体分析，直至逐条语句的层面，使我们既能考察项目对其智能体提出的要求，也能考察这些要求中生成器、工具和共享文本的痕迹。 我们将这一描述与采用情况和文件历史测量、预先设定的假设检验，以及与项目特征的探索性关联相结合。 我们发布文件版本指针、标注、分类体系和汇总结果，而不重新分发语料库文本。

paragraphs.en: Chatlatanagulchai et al. [2026] coded the files of AIDev repositories into a taxonomy of instruction types, and Chatlatanagulchai et al. [2025] and Santos et al. [2026] studied CLAUDE.md files on their own. Mohsenimofidi et al. [2026] found context files in few mature repositories and identified several instruction styles; Galster et al. [2026b] , Galster et al. [2026c] catalogued the configuration mechanisms of current agents and observed a bottom-up convergence on AGENTS.md ; Cardoen et al. [2026] and Chakrabarti [2026] followed files over time; dos Santos et al. [2026] defined configuration smells; and Cursor rules have been studied separately [ Jiang and Nam, 2026 , Sun et al., 2026 ] . We differ in population and unit: a census of popular, active repositories not selected for agent use, with each repository’s files analysed together at the level of statements.

paragraphs.en: Controlled studies, mostly preprints, report mixed effects of instruction files on agents’ success and cost [ Gloaguen et al., 2026 , Lulla et al., 2026 , Khatri, 2026 ] , and observational work links file features to merge rates [ Arabat and Sayagh, 2026 ] . Adherence varies little with layout [ McMillan, 2026 ] . Preprints report that negative constraints help, although random rules helped as much as curated ones [ Zhang et al., 2026 ] , and that rules naming concrete commands or paths carry most of the gains in agent skills [ Wang et al., 2026 ] . We make no effect claims but measure, across a population, features this work names: prohibitions, concrete requirements, rationale and conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 受控研究（多为预印本）报告指令文件对智能体的成功率和成本影响不一 [ Gloaguen et al., 2026 , Lulla et al., 2026 , Khatri, 2026 ]，观察性研究则将文件特征与合并率联系起来 [ Arabat and Sayagh, 2026 ]。 遵循度随布局变化很小 [ McMillan, 2026 ]。 预印本报告否定性约束有帮助，尽管随机规则与精选规则的效果相当 [ Zhang et al., 2026 ]，并且指出在智能体技能中，命名具体命令或路径的规则贡献了大部分收益 [ Wang et al., 2026 ]。 我们不作效果方面的断言，而是在群体范围内测量本工作所命名的特征：禁止事项、具体要求、理由和条件。

paragraphs.en: Mining studies measure agent activity through commit trailers and pull requests and warn that the trace is incomplete and easily misread [ Robbes et al., 2026a , Robbes et al., 2026b , Khosravani and Mockus, 2026 , Yu et al., 2026 ] . paragraphs.en: We enumerated public GitHub repositories that, on 2026-10-16, had at least 1,000 stars, had been pushed to within the preceding 90 days, were neither forks nor archived, and had one of thirteen primary languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C#, C++, C, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Kotlin or Swift. paragraphs.en: We used Haiku to segment files into statements , each expressing one claim or instruction regardless of line boundaries. A directive is a statement with binding force, from a mandatory rule to a permission; descriptions and plain references are not directives. Rules on pull-request descriptions most often require a test plan (27.2% of the files with such rules), the project’s template and linked issues; rules on commit messages require the Conventional Commits format (36.7%). Rules on test writing prohibit trivial tests (8.1%) and weakening tests to make them pass (4.9%), and code-review rules disagree on style (7.0% ask reviewers to check it, 7.7% not to nitpick it). AI attribution splits projects: 7.5% of the repositories with commit-message rules prohibit it (95% CI 6.3–8.9) and 59 require it, while for pull requests 5.8% require disclosure of AI use and 1.9% prohibit it, mostly in different repositories.

paragraphs.en: In Fig. 3 , 80.9% of instruction sets mark at least one rule as mandatory and 77.8% prohibit something, yet prohibitions are on average 15.8% of a repository’s directives, and unmarked imperatives are the most common form. 82.9% give a reason at least once, but 74.0% of directives carry none, and only 10.8% of repositories cite an incident or evidence. paragraphs.en: Of the six hypotheses specified before fitting the association models ( Table 2 ), three are supported: more-starred repositories more often have rules on pull requests or AI contribution policy (H6; OR 1.36 per standard deviation of log stars), compiled-language repositories more often state how to build and run the project (H3; OR 1.68), and CLAUDE.md is more descriptive than AGENTS.md in the same repository (H5). More merged pull requests go with more workflow rules and fewer descriptions, but more human authors go with slightly fewer workflow rules, so H2 is mixed. The AI-share (H1) and emphasis (H4) hypotheses are not supported, with small significant effects against the prediction (IRR 0.977 and OR 0.93). H3, H6 and the pull-request part of H2 hold on the Sonnet sample and when either of the two largest languages is left out. The paired file comparison was informed by earlier pooled differences; the percentage-point estimate and other post hoc checks are distinguished in Section A.11 .

paragraphs.en: Agent instructions read like a compact onboarding document: what the project is, which commands to run, and how to work. Verification before declaring work done, test writing, the instruction files themselves and code design are among the most common specific rule subjects, yet each appears in under half of repositories. Projects share broad concerns more than individual requirements. Project knowledge appears in 86.2% of instruction sets, with rules on that area in 54.3%. The files give an agent starting a task both project context and expectations for its work.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体指令读起来像一份简明的入职文档：项目是什么、要运行哪些命令、以及如何开展工作。 在宣布工作完成前进行验证、编写测试、指令文件本身以及代码设计，是最常见的具体规则主题之列，但每一项出现在不到一半的代码库中。 各项目共享的宽泛关注点多于各自的具体要求。 项目知识出现在 86.2% 的指令集中，该领域的规则出现在 54.3% 中。 这些文件为开始任务的智能体提供了项目背景信息以及对其工作的期望。

paragraphs.en: Rules on collaboration artefacts name specific requirements, such as a test plan, linked issues or a commit format; in agent skills, a preprint finds that concrete instructions of this kind carry most of the measured gains [ Wang et al., 2026 ] . Yet most directives give no reason, few cite an incident, and marked obligations and prohibitions are a minority of directives. Whether reasons or emphasis change what agents do remains open.
paragraphs.zh: 关于协作产物的规则会规定具体要求，例如测试计划、关联的问题单或提交格式；在智能体技能方面，一篇预印本发现，这类具体指令贡献了大部分可测量的收益 [ Wang et al., 2026 ] 。 然而，大多数指令没有给出理由，很少引用事故，且带有明确标记的义务和禁令只占指令的少数。 理由或强调是否会改变智能体的行为，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: One in four repositories in our census of popular, active GitHub projects in thirteen languages has root instructions for coding agents. These files put project knowledge beside concrete expectations about code, testing and collaboration. They also expose unsettled norms: projects disagree about AI attribution, and most directives offer no explanation. Generator signatures, shared text and tool-inserted blocks reveal the role of reusable text, while file histories show that projects keep editing the instructions. Exploratory analyses associate activity with process-oriented content and find LLM and agent projects over-represented among adopters. The census and released annotations provide a basis for studying how this practice develops, and whether agents follow the expectations projects write down.

paragraphs.en: We calibrated the prompt against the reference study’s own human labels: 324 files with stored text, split into fixed halves of 162. paragraphs.en: Statement codes are pooled over a repository’s coded files, counting identical copies once. For each code we report the share of repositories with at least one statement or rule with it, and the mean share of a repository’s statements. Headline estimates use Sonnet’s codes on the 992 sample repositories whose whole instruction set Sonnet coded, weighted by the inverse of their inclusion probability, because the sample was drawn by file. Intervals come from a weighted cluster bootstrap over repositories. Census estimates use Haiku’s codes, calibrated to Sonnet’s where that lowers the error on a held-out half of the sample.
paragraphs.zh: 陈述编码在代码库的已编码文件上进行汇总，相同的副本只计一次。 对每种编码，我们报告至少含有一条该编码的陈述或规则的代码库占比，以及一个代码库的陈述中该编码的平均占比。 总体估计使用 Sonnet 在其编码了完整指令集的 992 个抽样代码库上的编码，并按抽样概率的倒数加权，因为样本是按文件抽取的。 置信区间来自对代码库的加权整簇自助法（cluster bootstrap）。 普查估计使用 Haiku 的编码，并在能降低保留一半样本上误差的情况下，将其校准到 Sonnet 的编码。

We repeated the classification with Sonnet 5.5 on a random sample, and the human reviewer checked a stratified sample before seeing model labels, with each repository’s README and latest release available ( Section 4.5 ).

paragraphs.en: The models and profiles use the 5,586 instruction sets with at least 5 statements and Haiku’s raw codes, as in the prespecified tests. paragraphs.en: Spot checks of the models’ reading. Statements were drawn from the validation files, stratified by kind and subject area, and limited to statements whose spans were all verbatim. paragraphs.en: The reviewer accepted the boundaries of 92% of the 60 reviewed statements, the restatements and extracted elements of 93%, and the free-text subjects of 95% ( Table 3 ). The blind reading agrees with the models on description versus rule in 82–83% of statements when references are excluded, but only at κ \kappa 0.33–0.40 on the three kinds and in 43–50% on the subject area and 32–37% on the subject. The reviewer rarely used reference : a command list with comments read as a rule, because in this genre one line often describes, refers and instructs at once. The models agree with each other far better than with this human reading, as in the comparison with the reference study’s coders ( κ \kappa 0.67–0.80 between models against 0.46–0.52 with humans), a pattern noted for LLM annotation in other fields [ Gilardi et al., 2023 , Ziems et al., 2024 ] . These checks support extraction in the reviewed sample; subject categories and element-category and stance assignments remain model-defined.
paragraphs.zh: 审阅者接受了 60 条受审语句中 92% 的边界、93% 的重述与提取要素，以及 95% 的自由文本主题（表 3）。 在排除参考文献时，盲读与模型在 82–83% 的语句上对描述与规则的判定一致，但在三类判定上仅为 κ 0.33–0.40，在主题领域上为 43–50%，在主题上为 32–37%。 审阅者很少使用参考文献：带有注释的命令列表被读作规则，因为在这种文体中，一行往往同时进行描述、引用和指示。 模型之间的一致性远高于与这一人工阅读的一致性，如同与参考研究中编码员比较所示（模型之间 κ 为 0.67–0.80，而与人工比较为 0.46–0.52），这一模式在其他领域的 LLM 标注研究中也有报告 [Gilardi et al., 2023, Ziems et al., 2024]。 这些检查支持在受审样本中进行提取；主题类别、要素类别及立场分配仍由模型定义。
